messages:
anna: Quick sync — draft for DP invite conversion split-test. Want to validate two things: messaging copy vs. incentive structure. Goal: move from 18% baseline invite-to-commit to 30% in 4 weeks. Plan below, need estimates on capacity + success criteria.

mike: can you paste the variants?

anna: Variant A: product-focused copy (no $), callout 'join early & influence roadmap'; Variant B: incentive ($100 credit + priority support).

anna: Sample sizes: 300 per arm min, aim for 2k invites total over 3 weeks.

sylvia: Ops question — can dedicated team handle onboarding 600 new DP participants in peak week? we have 3 SEs + 1 solutions engineer.

tariq: SEs can onboard ~8/day each. So 600 peak means we'll need staged onboarding. Suggest rolling wave + automated onboarding email.

jess: On feedback loops: propose weekly 30-min check-ins for cohort + asynchronous structured feedback via Notion form. Also short weekly NPS + 3 core task completion metrics.

mike: sample copy snippets:

```
Variant A: "Shape the product — join our early partner cohort and influence roadmap"
Variant B: "Get $100 credit + priority onboarding — join now"
```

anna: Success criteria for pilot: 30% commit rate OR 250 active trial users with 2+ integrations OR median NPS >=7 at week 2. Any one of these triggers move to broader invite.

sylvia: Risk: incentive could attract low-signal partners. Suggest gating with a 2-question screener about use case & data sensitivity.

tariq: Agreed. Screener: 1) Primary integration goal 2) Compliance requirements (yes/no).

ops-bot: Form updated — DP intake form v2 published: https://notion.so/redwood/dp-intake-v2

jess: For evaluation, we should track: invite_sent, clicked, scheduled_offering, committed, first_api_call, weekly_active, nps_score. I'll add these to product dashboard.

mike: Also track retention after 14 days and token spend delta vs baseline.

anna: Timeline: Week 0: finalize copy + screener. Week 1: send 1k soft invites (A/B). Week 2: analyze commit rate, onboard rolling cohort. Week 4: decision.

tariq: On rollout policies: if A beats B by >7pp at p<0.05, scale that variant. If neither, iterate creative and re-run.

jess: Can we cap incentives to only those who complete onboarding + 2-week active usage? reduces gaming.

anna: Yep add to incentive T&Cs.

mike: Question on data collection/privacy — need to ensure consent text in invite for usage metrics.

sylvia: Legal will need to approve wording. I'll ping @legal.

anna: OK — action items: mike craft 4 copy variants by EOD tomorrow, jess wire dashboard events, tariq propose onboarding wave schedule, sylvia confirm SE capacity + legal loop. tagging weekly sync Thurs 10:00. :rocket:

tariq: noted, I'll sketch wave plan.

jess: adding tracking ticket in product board.

mike: done — first drafts live at https://docs.redwood/invite-copy

anna: thanks all. I'll convert this to GH issue after lunch.
